headline: Lightspeed Commerce Reports Q2 2027 Financial Results
summary: Lightspeed Commerce reported second quarter revenue of $323.8 million, representing 15% year-over-year organic revenue growth. Gross profit reached $142.8 million with an 11% organic growth rate.
why: Lightspeed is a cloud-based commerce platform providing point-of-sale and e-commerce software for retail and hospitality businesses globally.
